<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sysapproval_approver</collection><condition>current.state == 'rejected' && current.sysapproval.sys_class_name == 'x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement'</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Copy Rejection Reason to Reimbursement</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    // Get the reimbursement record
    var reimbursement = current.sysapproval.getRefRecord();

    // Get rejection reason from comments
    var reason = current.comments;

    // Only proceed if everything is valid
    if (reimbursement && reason) {

        // Add entry to Work Notes
        reimbursement.work_notes = "❌ Rejected by " 
            + current.approver.getDisplayValue() 
            + ":\n" + reason;

        // OPTIONAL: If you create a separate field
        // reimbursement.u_rejection_reason = reason;

        // Save the record
        reimbursement.update();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>sharik.mir</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-03-26 08:24:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>4e1712ee2f3bf690d2a0d68fcea4e35b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Copy Rejection Reason to Reimbursement</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="GateNow" source="x_enno_gatenow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="GateNow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_4e1712ee2f3bf690d2a0d68fcea4e35b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>sharik.mir</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-03-26 08:24:16</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=4e1712ee2f3bf690d2a0d68fcea4e35b"/></record_update>
